per_question.answer: To avoid academic warning, an undergraduate needs to maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 2.00. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Academic Assessment > Academic Warning/Probation]

If a student's CGPA stays below 2.00 for three consecutive semesters, their admission to the University is automatically closed. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 5. Academic Assessment > Academic Warning/Probation]
A student can repeat a maximum of 2 courses in a summer semester, with associated labs if any. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 6. Rules for Summer Semester]

Students earning an SGPA of 4.00 with at least 30 credit hours shall be included in a prestigious list called Rector’s List of Honors. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 7. Awards and the Honor System > Rector’s List of Honors]

If a teacher refers a cheating case to the Department Disciplinary Committee, the maximum punishment of 'F' grade can be awarded in that course. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 8. Academic Honesty > Penalties for Academic Dishonesty]

A student is not allowed to submit an assignment written by a generative AI tool as their own work. This is because using Generative AI software to create entire assessments that are then disguised as the student's own work is not acceptable, as stated in Passage A. According to the Fee Refund Policy, if a student leaves within the first 15 days of classes, 80% of the tuition fee is refunded. [fee-structure-page.html / Fee Refund Policy]

A faculty member must have been a full-time faculty member for more than 1 year to be eligible to start a technical start-up. [faculty-entrepreneurship-and-technical-start-ups-policy.pdf / 1. Purpose > Eligibility criteria for a technical start-up]

The Islamabad campus had a highly qualified, fully committed, and professionally stimulated faculty dedicated to academic excellence, with faculty members who excel in teaching competence and are adept at integrating the latest advancements in science and technology into their instruction. [annual-report-2023-24.pdf / ISLAMABAD, PAKISTAN > Islamabad Campus]

The deadline to withdraw from a course is the last day of the makeup week of every semester, as stated in section 4.25 of the Academic Rules Handbook, June 2026. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 4. Registration > Withdrawal from a Course]
A regular semester is spread over 16 weeks of teaching, one makeup week and 2 weeks of final examinations. [academic-rules-handbook-jun-2026.pdf / 1. Introduction > Academic Year]
Under the older 2023 academic rules, the deadline to withdraw from a course was the last day of classes. [undergraduate-academic-rules-aug-2023.pdf / 4. Registration > Withdrawal from a Course]
